user.title: Connect a WooBee controller
user.description: Select a WooBee V2 / WB-4 visible to Home Assistant Bluetooth. Authentication and a read of identity and state will be performed. No password is required.

reconfigure.title: Change Bluetooth address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the same physical controller. Entity and device identities are preserved. Do not use this flow to replace the controller.

data.same_controller: I confirm this is the same physical controller

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Check Bluetooth range and available connections, then retry.
error.invalid_response: The controller returned an unsupported or invalid response.
error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address or CoreBluetooth UUID.
error.confirm_controller: Confirm this is the same physical controller.
error.wrong_controller: The serial number does not match the configured controller.
error.identity_unavailable: The original serial number is unavailable. Restore connectivity at the old address to read it before retrying.

abort.no_devices_found: No connectable Bluetooth devices found. Bring the controller within range and retry.

start_irrigation.name: Start irrigation
start_irrigation.description: Start one valve for a whole number of minutes. Stop any active irrigation first.

set_default_duration.name: Set default duration
set_default_duration.description: Set this zone’s default opening duration in HA without starting irrigation or changing controller programs.

authentication_failed.message: Controller authentication failed; the next poll opens a fresh session.

snapshot_failed.message: Unable to read controller snapshot; check Bluetooth reachability and response data.

invalid_irrigation.message: Zone must be an integer from 1 to 4 and duration must be a whole number from 1 to {max_minutes} minutes.

invalid_minutes.message: Duration must be a whole number from 1 to {max_minutes} minutes.

irrigation_active.message: Irrigation is already active. Stop all irrigation before starting a zone.

state_unconfirmed.message: The controller did not confirm the requested irrigation state. The command may have been rejected or may still be taking effect; check the device before sending another command.

command_failed.message: Unable to confirm irrigation command. Check Bluetooth and controller state before retrying; the command has not been repeated.

command_cancelled.message: Irrigation command cancelled; outcome unknown. Check controller state before sending another command.
